title: Prospective M006f evidence capture design
hypothesis: Exact prospective market evidence can be captured as a local immutable snapshot and transformed offline into the M006f market-evidence contract without introducing network, execution, strategy, risk, or promotion authority.
result: PASS: offline capture and sealing prototype preserves exact bid/ask, deterministic AUD conversion and byte-for-byte SHA-256 provenance, while remaining contract-valid and governance-isolated.
